text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day of the Mile
Championship. While
seeing off Nishino
Flower as usual...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey-hey! Heliboss in the house! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios crashes in with a loud
entrance. She debuted before Nishino
Flower and is one of
the racers most
favored to win today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Helios. Let's have a good race
today!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Vibe check! Yup, I'm feelin' goated!
Time to fly
outta the gates and pop off!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, me and the girls are off to the
paddock!
C'mon, BB Flo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wha—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! You know how it goes, gang!
Let's
gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's hype it up, fam! It's time to get
glam!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's hype it up, fam. It's time to get
glam.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hype it up, fam. Time to get glam.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Which one of you partyers is ready to
get
smooched by the goddess of
victory? 'Cause I
know I am!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't tell me you're waiting on me!
And who
said I wanted to party?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Girl?! You mean you're not down bad for the goddess?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh! Everyone knows partyers pop off
on
miles! It's about to be a pop-off
party!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: O-oh, really?! Then, u-um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Let's... party!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Woo! ...Did I say that right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh geez,
you're so pure it's adorable. It's
like I'm
in the presence of an angel.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
BB Flo, you slay, girl! ☆ And now that
Nature's in
a party mood too, let's get
lit!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's hear it, party girls! ! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: L-let's get lit!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. This is fun.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Whatever race she runs in, Helios always
brings
with her a warm, sunny breeze.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Your performance at the Sprinters
Stakes is still fresh in my memory. I'm
excited to see how you'll
sail through
the air here too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Let's get li—oh, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's get lit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Um, I'm looking forward to
running with
you!
